book.arcane-artistry-elements.entry.fire: Channels the raw heat of the inferno. Requires a blaze rod.
A blaze rod can be used as a staff of fire.

Pattern: **Up, Down**
Mana: 30

Hurls an explosive ball of fire where you are looking.
book.arcane-artistry-elements.entry.wate: Draws on the depths of the tides. Requires a breeze rod.
A breeze rod can be used as a staff of water.

Pattern: **Left, Right**
Mana: 15

Launches a bursting orb of water.
Gaze into the patterns of your staff.

Use a [staff](entry:arcane-artistry:staffs) on a crystal ball to look into its patterns. Every pattern you have cast with that staff is revealed there, and patterns that form a spell are marked.

Drag to look around, scroll to zoom and click a pattern to focus it.
Using a book on a crystal ball binds it into a new compendium.
book.arcane-artistry.entry.guide_book.de: A record of everything you have learned about the arcane.
book.arcane-artistry.entry.guide_book.pa:
This compendium records your arcane studies. Every symbol on the map is an *entry*; click one to read it.

New entries appear once you have read the entries they build upon. Entries that are {#8B0000}locked{} still need something from you before they can be read.
The compendium is made from an ordinary book. Use one on an awakened [Crystal Ball](entry:arcane-artistry:crystal_ball) to bind it.
book.arcane-artistry.entry.lapis_crystal: A crystal humming with arcane potential.
Using a lapis crystal on an [Orb Ring](entry:arcane-artistry:orb_ring) sets it into the ring, creating a **Crystal Ball**.
book.arcane-artistry.entry.mana.page0.te:
Every spell costs mana, and the mana bar shows how much you have left. Mana regenerates over time: slowly at first, then faster the longer you go without casting.

Without enough mana for a spell, the spell fizzles.
book.arcane-artistry.entry.mana.title: Mana
book.arcane-artistry.entry.orb_ring.desc: A golden cradle for a crystal.
book.arcane-artistry.entry.orb_ring.page: The orb ring has to be placed on top of a sturdy block. On its own it does nothing, but it can hold a [Lapis Crystal](entry:arcane-artistry:lapis_crystal).
Some items can serve as a staff. Hold *use* with one to begin casting, then move the mouse in strokes: **up**, **down**, **left** or **right**. Let go to finish the pattern.

If the pattern matches a spell of that staff, the spell is cast. Every pattern you try is remembered by the [Crystal Ball](entry:arcane-artistry:crystal_ball).
book.arcane-artistry.entry.staffs.title: Staffs
options.arcane-artistry.max_staff_moveme: How far the staff in first person can move from its center while casting.
options.arcane-artistry.stroke_threshold: How far the mouse must move while casting before a stroke is registered. Lower is more sensitive.
